explanation: It only fires at D2 when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition; it is 0 at every D1 and GO step, after any rare transition, and whenever the choice was a1. On those a2-to-S2-common steps it reads about 9-10 early in the episode (trials 5-16), when the previous trial was rewarded and a2 has been chosen repeatedly; it falls to about 7-8 just after an unrewarded trial, about 3-6 in mid-episode (trials 35-60) and near 0 late in the episode (after trial 80) or after a run of unrewarded trials.
